title: Five Haiku
author: Randy Brooks
text:
pondside lizard
letting the heat build up
inside me

•

shallow sunfish nests
the dark rings
under soft eyes

•

tadpoles jiggle
remember the day we
found our legs?

•

the weight of bills
both carried away
in a riptide

•

spider man
in the pear tree
hand-me-down pjs

•

• • •

Floating World

afloat in the lake
up to my chin
mud turtle`s view

nature lookout!
the chipmunk pauses
for a second sip

a complaint about
my drift to the dock
heron squawks

eyes out of the water
just like me
nonchalant snake

chipmunk beach
they don`t mind me
offshore

•
